items.title: Commission accepts Temu's action plan to remedy the breach of the Digital Services Act
items.title_zh: 欧委会接受 Temu 补救《数字服务法》违规的行动计划
items.summary: Temu's five-measure action plan follows the €200 million non-compliance decision and includes an interim risk assessment.
items.summary_zh: Temu 的五项措施行动计划承接 2 亿欧元不合规决定，并包含临时风险评估。

items.title: Commission to investigate how Booking.com combats scams and fraud under the Digital Services Act
items.title_zh: 欧委会调查 Booking.com 如何依据《数字服务法》打击诈骗与欺诈
items.summary: Formal proceedings focus on fraudulent listings, phishing scams and paid boosted listings that are not clearly labelled as ads.
items.summary_zh: 正式程序聚焦诈骗房源、钓鱼诈骗以及未清晰标识为广告的付费提升排序房源。

items.title: Commission fines AliExpress €550 million for breaching the Digital Services Act
items.title_zh: 欧委会因 AliExpress 违反《数字服务法》罚款 5.5 亿欧元
items.summary: The Commission found that AliExpress failed to diligently assess and mitigate risks relating to illegal, unsafe or counterfeit products.
items.summary_zh: 欧委会认定 AliExpress 未充分评估和降低非法、危险或仿冒商品传播风险。

items.title: Commission preliminarily finds the addictive design of Instagram and Facebook in breach of the Digital Services Act
items.title_zh: 欧委会初步认定 Instagram 与 Facebook 的上瘾式设计违反《数字服务法》
items.summary: The preliminary findings focus on infinite scroll, autoplay, push notifications and personalised recommender systems.
items.summary_zh: 初步认定聚焦无限滚动、自动播放、推送通知和个性化推荐系统。

items.title: Commission designates ChatGPT, Reddit, Roblox under Digital Services Act
items.title_zh: 欧委会依据《数字服务法》指定 ChatGPT、Reddit 和 Roblox
items.summary: ChatGPT was designated a VLOSE and Reddit and Roblox were designated VLOPs, triggering enhanced obligations after four months.
items.summary_zh: ChatGPT 被指定为 VLOSE，Reddit 与 Roblox 被指定为 VLOP，四个月后适用增强义务。

items.title: Commission preliminary finds TikTok in breach of the Digital Services Act for failing to ensure safe accounts for minors
items.title_zh: 欧委会初步认定 TikTok 未确保未成年人账户安全，违反《数字服务法》
items.summary: The Commission sent preliminary findings on the default visibility and recommendation settings for minors’ public accounts.
items.summary_zh: 欧委会就未成年人公开账户的默认可见范围和推荐设置发出初步认定。

items.title: Commission accepts X's action plan to comply with the Digital Services Act
items.title_zh: 欧委会接受 X 遵守《数字服务法》的行动计划
items.summary: The action plan follows the Commission's non-compliance decision and sets out remediation work on ad transparency and researcher access.
items.summary_zh: 行动计划承接欧委会的不合规决定，覆盖广告透明度与研究者访问的整改工作。

items.title: Commission preliminarily finds TikTok and Meta in breach of their transparency obligations
items.title_zh: 欧委会初步认定 TikTok 与 Meta 违反透明度义务
items.summary: Preliminary findings concern transparency obligations, researcher access and related DSA evidence requests.
items.summary_zh: 初步认定涉及透明度义务、研究者访问以及相关 DSA 证据请求。

items.title: Commission requests information from Apple, Booking.com, Google and Microsoft on financial scams
items.title_zh: 欧委会就金融诈骗向 Apple、Booking.com、Google 与 Microsoft 发出信息请求
items.summary: The requests ask how platforms identify and mitigate fraudulent ads, listings, applications and websites.
items.summary_zh: 信息请求聚焦平台如何识别并降低诈骗广告、房源、应用和网站风险。
